entries.title: Proverbs 28:2
segments:
CHAP. XXVIII. 
 
  V. 2. But-By a wise and good prince.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:3
segments: V. 3. It like-Is like a violent rain or flood, which washes away the very seeds in the earth.  He is the worst of all oppressors.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:4
segments: V. 4. Contend-Are so far from praising them, that they severely reprove them.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:5
segments: V. 5. Judgment-What is just and right.  All things-Which are necessary to be known by them.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:6
segments: V. 6. Better-In a much happier condition.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:10
segments: V. 10. Causeth-That by evil counsel, or example, or artifice, draws them into evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:12
segments: V. 12. Rejoice-Are promoted.  Glory-In that common-wealth. Rise-Are advanced to authority.  Hidden-Wise and good men, who only are worthy of the name of men, withdraw themselves into obscure places.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:14
segments: V. 14. Alway-In all times, companies, and conditions.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:16
segments: V. 16. Oppressor-The tyranny of a prince, is a manifest sign of folly. Prolong-By God's favour, the peace and satisfaction of his own mind, and the hearty love of his people.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:17
segments: V. 17. Violence-That sheddeth any man's blood.  Shall flee-Shall speedily be destroyed.  Shall slay-None should desire or endeavour to save him from his deserved punishment.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:18
segments: V. 18. At once-Once for all; so he shall never rise more.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:20
segments: V. 20. Faithful-Who deals truly and justly in all his transactions.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:21
segments: V. 21. For-When a man hath once accustomed himself to take bribes, a very small advantage will make him sell justice.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:22
segments: V. 22. Evil eye-Is uncharitable to persons in want, and envious to those who get any thing besides him.  Poverty-And consequently that he shall need the pity and help of others.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:24
segments: V. 24. The same-Is a thief and robber.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:25
segments: V. 25. Fat-Shall live happily and comfortably.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:26
segments: V. 26. Wisely-Distrusting his own judgment, and seeking the advice of others, and especially of God.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:28
segments: V. 28. Men-Righteous men are afraid to appear publickly.
